baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative ض ل ل, the ج ب ل plus ك ث ر object, and the closing ع ق ل question.
baseline_models.mechanism: An adversarial agent moves a very large human aggregate away from guidance, while rational discernment should have checked that movement and restrained participation in it.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from guidance supplies the off-course event assigned by the causative verb to the adversary.
Mountain-scale abundance supplies the great human aggregate affected by the deviation.
Numerical increase intensifies the scale rather than changing the kind of aggregate.
Intellect that checks ignorance supplies the failed counterforce to being led off course.

changed_reading.before: He misled many of you; did you not understand?
changed_reading.after: He drove a vast human aggregate off purposeful guidance; why did discriminating restraint not arrest that movement?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The unusual ج ب ل noun is modified by ك ث ر inside the object of causative ض ل ل.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object can be heard not merely as a count of separate persons but as a densely gathered, created human stock whose shared formation has become a medium of misguidance.

activation_trace.role: Departure from right direction remains the governing event for the collective object.
Created constitution supplies the sense of a human stock formed with shared dispositions.
A huge mountain-like collectivity gives that formed stock social density and scale.
Coalescence into a dense quantity makes multiplicity function as a collective formation.

changed_reading.after: Misguidance has penetrated a densely formed human collectivity, not merely accumulated isolated errors.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction ت ك و ن plus ت ع ق ل places reasoning inside a state-of-being question.
baseline_models.mechanism: The wording asks whether rational restraint ever occurred or persisted as their condition, making the reproach durative rather than a complaint about one missed thought.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time make reasoning a state that should have become actual and sustained.
Discernment that restrains ignorance defines the expected enduring capacity.
The tether image turns sustained reasoning into active holding rather than passive possession.

changed_reading.before: Why did you not think at the relevant moment?
changed_reading.after: Why was rational self-restraint never present as an operative condition among you?

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah sequence supplies an offered bridle and straight route, then collars and barriers, then a preserved covenant beside the adversary's long cord. This strengthens a reading of ع ق ل as voluntary inner binding: failure to hold oneself to the route permits hostile pull and culminates in imposed fixation.

activation_trace.role: Off-course motion is the focus event whose control mechanism the context clarifies.
A camel tether supplies the focus image of deliberate self-binding against drift.
A bridle within wisdom supplies an early instrument for governing otherwise uncontrolled motion.
The straight road gives the directional norm from which the focus multitude departs.
A collar fastening the body materializes restraint after it is no longer voluntarily exercised.
Barriers closing gaps before and behind turn failed navigation into spatial confinement.
A preserved pact supplies the normative bond to which inner restraint should have held.
A long tightening cord supplies a rival pull immediately before the focus reports mass deviation.
The repeated straight road places the focus question directly after a renewed directional norm.

structural_cues: The straight road appears near the opening at 36:4 and again immediately before the focus at 36:61.
Collars and front-back barriers at 36:8-9 precede the covenant, adversary, route, and failed-reason sequence at 36:60-62.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bridle, routes, collars, walls, a preserved pact, and a long cord; I infer a movement from rejected inner restraint to adversarial pull and imposed fixation. A live alternative is that the collars and walls depict condition or consequence without this causal staging.

changed_reading.before: Did you not intellectually recognize Satan's misguidance?
changed_reading.after: Why did you not bind judgment to the covenantal route before the adversary's pull and external bonds fixed your course?

context_deltas.mechanism: Generations, dispersed descendants, and the sons of Adam extend the focus multitude through lineage; universal gathering then reverses crowd cover by sorting and witnessing. The vast formed mass is therefore both the medium through which misguidance scales and the collective from which accountable persons must be distinguished.

activation_trace.role: Created constitution anchors the multitude as human stock rather than an abstract number.
Mountain-like abundance gives that stock collective scale.
Numerical predominance supplies the social pressure by which multitude can masquerade as validation.
People bound within one era divide the aggregate into successive historical cohorts.
Smallness spreading outward gives descendants a dispersive mechanism across the collective.
Rejoining what was scattered brings every cohort into one present aggregate.
Sorting one thing visibly from another reverses the anonymity of the assembled mass.
A mental power that extracts meanings bridges judicial sorting to the discernment missing in the focus.
Lineage traced to an origin names the addressed multitude as a transgenerational family.
Evidence declared from knowledge assigns responsibility after the crowd has been separated.

structural_cues: A lone man comes from the city's far edge at 36:20 against a rejecting population, so numerical isolation does not mark error.
Destroyed generations are all brought present at 36:31-32; the same all-gathered movement at 36:53 is followed by separation at 36:59 and bodily testimony at 36:65.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cohorts, descendants, lineage, gathering, sorting, and testimony; I infer that crowd formation transmits and conceals error until judgment individuates it. A live alternative is that these are separate resurrection scenes without a social mechanism for the focus multitude.

changed_reading.before: Satan happened to mislead a large number of individuals.
changed_reading.after: Misguidance scales through a transgenerational crowd whose numerical force cannot excuse anyone, because the gathered mass will be sorted back into accountable witnesses and actors.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heedlessness, reminder, preserved traces, repeated signs, the repeated reason refrain, and forgetting one's own creation form a memory circuit. This activates the lost-preservation branch of ض ل ل: misguidance is not lack of evidence but failure to retain and relate what has already been marked.

activation_trace.role: Loss of what should be preserved recasts deviation as a breakdown of moral memory.
Understanding that checks folly supplies the operation that should retain and connect evidence.
Leaving something outside wakeful attention names the initial failure of retention.
Bringing something back after forgetting supplies the corrective memory operation.
A remaining mark that discloses what occurred makes past conduct available to recollection and inference.
Visible markers repeatedly arriving yet being turned aside show that evidence is supplied but not integrated.
The repeated appeal to restraining understanding links the focus failure to an observable life-cycle reversal.
Loss of remembered origin provides the surah's explicit late example of reasoning severed from its own evidence.

structural_cues: The surah repeatedly labels earth, night, and the carried descendants as signs at 36:33, 36:37, and 36:41, then describes recurrent turning away at 36:46.
The focus question is echoed at 36:68, and the final disputant at 36:78 forgets the very creation from which the required inference should begin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgetting, remembrance, residual marks, visible signs, and repeated reason language; I infer that reasoning here means retaining and comparing those data over time. A live alternative is a simpler contrast between heedlessness and cognition without a specific memory mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They lacked enough understanding to identify misguidance.
changed_reading.after: They repeatedly let disclosed signs, remembered origin, and preserved traces fall out of relation, so misguidance operated as failed retention rather than missing evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated ك و ن forms surround the focus with former conduct, fixed placement, and sudden becoming; aging is then inverted and the ع ق ل refrain repeated, before the closing command of being. The focus construction therefore indicts the absence of a durable rational mode of being across changing states.

activation_trace.role: Presence and occurrence through time anchor reasoning as an actual condition.
Discernment that checks ignorance defines the quality expected to inhabit that condition.
Formerly present conduct makes habitual being the object of exact recompense.
Place and standing turn a condition into something on which a person can become fixed.
Life extended through time gives the interval across which rational recognition should mature.
Turning a thing upside down makes changing condition materially observable.
The repeated reason refrain explicitly applies discernment to temporal reversal.
Immediate coming-to-be closes the surah with the maximal contrast to reason that never became operative.

structural_cues: Former-state constructions cluster at 36:54 and 36:63-65 around the focus's own state-of-being question.
The same reason refrain follows age reversal at 36:68, while 36:82 closes with an explicit command and occurrence of being.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated being forms, habitual deeds, fixed state, temporal inversion, and immediate becoming; I infer an aspectual-ethical emphasis on reason as a durable condition. A live alternative is that most being forms are ordinary auxiliaries and carry little independent force.

changed_reading.before: The auxiliary wording merely asks whether they ever thought.
changed_reading.after: Across a lifetime of changing and witnessed states, rational restraint never became their stable operative mode.

context_deltas.mechanism: Enumeration, exact recompense, a secured covenant, sealing, testimony, and bodily acquisition form an audit chain. The compensation branch of ع ق ل then activates a secondary legal sense: the question asks why they did not bind themselves by advance reckoning of liability before the evidence was closed.

activation_trace.role: A fixed compensatory liability supplies the exploratory bridge from reasoning to accountable reckoning.
Exhaustive numerical accounting supplies a complete record before judgment.
Matching an act with its return makes the recorded account consequential.
A secured undertaking carrying recourse or guarantee gives the command a liability-bearing bond.
An assured preventing seal closes one channel of self-presentation in the audit.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies admissible evidence from the body.
Acquisitive limbs connect what was earned to the very organs that testify.

structural_cues: Deeds and their traces are written and counted at 36:12 before the judgment scene.
Exact recompense at 36:54 leads through the covenant at 36:60 to sealed mouths and testifying limbs at 36:65.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accounting, matched return, warranty, sealing, testimony, and acquisitive limbs; I extend the compensation branch of ع ق ل into anticipatory self-reckoning. The materially live alternative is the primary cognitive sense, with the legal branch contributing imagery but not a distinct reading.

changed_reading.before: Why did you not understand the prohibition?
changed_reading.after: Why did you not reckon and bind yourselves against liability under the preserved covenant before the record and bodily evidence settled the account?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-maps human moral agency to livestock handling and uses distant rope and animal branches. It remains anchored in the focus's strayed-beast branch of ض ل ل and camel-tether branch of ع ق ل, while 36:60 supplies the adversary's long cord and 36:71-72 supplies owned, subdued cattle. Downstream prose should render it only as a secondary material analogy, not as a claim that ج ب ل literally means herd or that humans lack agency.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causative ض ل ل, the huge ج ب ل plus ك ث ر object, and the ع ق ل closing question support a controlled straying-and-tethering analogy.

activation_trace.role: An ownerless animal left astray supplies the zoomorphic shape of the causative deviation.
Being driven onto an affair gives the huge collective an exploratory compelled-cohort force.
Great number expands the straying image from one animal to a human-scale drove.
Tethering a camel supplies the absent countermeasure: deliberate self-restraint.
A long tightening cord gives the adversary a rival means of directing the collective.
Livestock and camels make the focus tether image materially present later in the surah.
Ownership and disposal give humans control over the animals and sharpen the reversal of agency.
Taming and making tractable supplies the animal-control operation humans receive but fail to internalize.

changed_reading.before: Satan misled many people who failed to think.
changed_reading.after: The adversary's rival cord drove a huge human drove astray; those who master tethered livestock failed to exercise the inward halter of reason.

strongest_changes: Reason becomes active self-binding to a route and covenant, contrasted with hostile pull, collars, and barriers.
The huge formed multitude becomes a transgenerational crowd that judgment gathers, sorts, and returns to individual evidence.
Misguidance becomes failed retention of reminders, signs, origin, and traces rather than a mere shortage of information.
The state-of-being construction becomes a reproach for reason never becoming a durable operative condition.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus's restraint imagery unusually concrete: wisdom as a bridle, reason as a tether, straight roads, external bonds, a preserved covenant, later sorting, and the exact reason refrain at 36:68. It also exposed a contained animal-control reversal and a branch-distant legal account that a conservative reading would likely flatten.
remaining_uncertainties: The created-stock and compelled-cohort branches of ج ب ل may be lexical coloration rather than active senses of the focus noun.
The compensation and livestock-tether readings are visibly anchored but remain branch-distant and should not displace the primary cognitive reading.
The repeated ك و ن pattern may carry durative ethical force, or most instances may function only as ordinary auxiliaries.
